title: A Spare Android Stick Becomes a Kitchen Glucose Clock | vitalii.no
description:
Turning a cheap Android TV stick into a dedicated kitchen display normally means buying Fully Kiosk's PLUS licence just to force the screen to stay on one web page. Even then the screen would show a battery-draining idle animation or quietly revert to the regular Android TV home screen the moment nobody was looking at it.

I wrote a minimal WebView HOME app that registers itself as the stick's actual launcher, so it boots straight into a bridge page showing glucose, local time, and the weather pulled from a cached forecast proxy — no licence required. After a few idle minutes it switches to a screensaver instead of draining the battery, lets the display colour be set from a phone, and shows stale glucose readings greyed out and struck through with the exact number of minutes since the last update.

Result: the kitchen TV now runs as a dedicated glucose-and-weather clock for the cost of the stick alone, and a stale reading is impossible to mistake for a current one.
